items.title: Content depth insufficient for March 2024 Core Update standards
items.description: Recent posts like 'Aged Lead Store Review (2026)' and 'Health Insurance Lead Pricing in 2026' lack the comprehensive analysis and original research required by Google's March 2024 Core Update. The update specifically targets affiliate content that doesn't provide substantial value beyond promotion.
items.recommendation: Expand key posts to 2,500-4,000 words with original research, comparative analysis tables, methodology sections, and verifiable data sources. Add sections on implementation challenges, ROI calculations, and industry benchmarks for each topic
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: YMYL expertise demonstration needs strengthening for financial content
items.description: As a financial services affiliate site, Google's enhanced E-E-A-T requirements demand stronger demonstration of Bill Rice's actual experience with aged leads and financial services. Current author bio lacks specific credentials and verifiable experience metrics.
items.recommendation: Enhance author bio with specific credentials (insurance licenses, years in industry, client portfolio size), add testimonials section, create detailed 'About Bill Rice' page with case studies, and include author bylines with expertise context on each post

items.title: Affiliate disclosure prominence insufficient for FTC 2024 standards
items.description: FTC's updated guidance requires affiliate disclosures to be more prominent and specific. Current site-wide disclosure may not meet the 'clear and conspicuous' standard, especially on mobile devices.
items.recommendation: Add prominent affiliate disclosure box at the top of each post containing affiliate links, use clear language like 'We earn a commission when you purchase through our links to AgedLeadStore.com', and ensure mobile visibility with contrasting colors
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Missing Product and Review schema reduces rich results eligibility
items.description: Posts reviewing AgedLeadStore.com and discussing lead pricing lack Product and Review schema markup, missing opportunities for rich results and reduced visibility in product-related searches.
items.recommendation: Implement Product schema for AgedLeadStore.com with aggregateRating, offers, and brand properties. Add Review schema to review posts with author, reviewRating, and reviewBody properties

items.title: Content pillar gaps undermine topical authority
items.description: With 0 playbooks and 0 guides, the site lacks comprehensive pillar content to establish topical authority in aged leads. This impacts Google's assessment of expertise breadth.
items.recommendation: Create 5-8 comprehensive pillar guides (3,000-5,000 words each): 'Complete Guide to Aged Leads', 'Insurance Agent's Playbook', 'Mortgage Broker's Guide', 'Solar Lead Conversion Playbook'. Link blog posts to relevant pillars
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Core Web Vitals INP optimization needed for May 2024 thresholds
items.description: Google's May 2024 Core Web Vitals update introduced stricter INP (Interaction to Next Paint) thresholds. Next.js sites often struggle with JavaScript bundle size affecting interaction responsiveness.
items.recommendation: Implement code splitting for affiliate tracking lib, optimize JavaScript bundle size, add loading states for affiliate link clicks, and ensure tap targets meet 44px minimum on mobile
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Glossary cross-linking underutilized for topic authority
items.description: With 77 glossary terms, there's significant opportunity to strengthen internal linking and topic authority by cross-linking glossary terms within blog content and creating definition clusters.
items.recommendation: Implement automatic glossary term linking within blog content, create 'Related Terms' sections on glossary pages, and build topic clusters around key terms like 'aged leads', 'lead scoring', 'conversion rates'
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Content freshness strategy needed for competitive topics
items.description: Topics like lead pricing and market trends require regular updates to maintain relevance. Google's Helpful Content system favors fresh, current information for time-sensitive queries.
items.recommendation: Implement quarterly content refresh schedule for pricing posts, market analysis, and trend content. Add 'Last Updated' dates prominently and create content calendar for seasonal updates
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Mobile affiliate link interaction optimization needed
items.description: Affiliate links may not provide optimal mobile experience with proper touch targets and loading feedback, potentially affecting mobile conversion rates.
items.recommendation: Ensure all affiliate links have minimum 44px touch targets, add loading states for affiliate redirects, and optimize button sizing for mobile interactions
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: Case studies lack verifiable sourcing for credibility
items.description: Content mentions success stories and case studies but lacks verifiable sources, client testimonials, or data attribution that would strengthen E-E-A-T signals.
items.recommendation: Add anonymized but specific case studies with verifiable metrics, client testimonials with permission, and data sources for all statistics and claims made in content
items.notes: Re-identified in audit 2026-05-13

items.title: FAQ schema opportunities on glossary pages
items.description: Glossary pages could benefit from FAQ schema to capture question-based queries and improve visibility for definition searches.
items.recommendation: Add FAQ schema to glossary pages with common questions like 'What are aged leads?', 'How much do aged leads cost?', 'Are aged leads worth it?' for key terms
